analysis.scope: Direct local struct object and one-layer endian field assignments from matching-width host struct-pointer parameter or simple declared local-pointer members; same-block sizeof(object)/&object at hci_req_add. Zero findings is out of scope, never normal. Source type spelling and bounded copy evidence do not establish a hardware defect.
assumptions: Linux fixed-width, __le/__be and cpu_to_le/be type/conversion spellings retain normal semantics unless redefined in bounded files
__KERNEL__=true; simple include guards and kernel ifdef only, other configurations remain unknown
bounded include reachability is spelling-based and is not a preprocessed translation unit
function/block extraction is lexical; no full C AST or control-flow, no layout/padding, no opcode schema, no compiled applicability or hardware execution
source host field annotations supply conditional representation evidence; source initialization/interprocedural value provenance not proven
typedef resolution and complex declarator syntax are unsupported; identified same-name declarators and complex source-pointer uses are conservatively refused
